role: post-hoc truth-fixed-x/y/origin-time depth ranking on spent development events, not full localization or independent validation
evaluation: for each FD depth event, fix x/y and origin time to its anchor (these are truth-based constraints); score all seven candidate depths with unshifted 25x1001 normalized waveform MSE=sum((prediction-FD)^2)/sum(FD^2); include learned vs FMM head with and without the previously fixed candidate-dependent approximate onset gate; no search optimizer or parameter tuning
limits: candidate depths and event sources were inspected previously; x/y and origin time fixed from truth; outcome cannot establish four-parameter localization, independent accuracy, source gradients through FMM or wave-equation fidelity
